raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner mis-disambiguated the target person despite initial search results pointing to Maria Luisa Gabriella of Savoy (Queen consort of Spain). It redirected the effort to Marie Thérèse Louise of Savoy (Princesse de Lamballe) and proposed her father-in-law instead, leading away from the correct answer (Louis, Grand Dauphin). This incorrect pivot initiated a chain of redundant searches and compounded errors (including misnaming the Lamballe father-in-law), resulting in the wrong solution.
